news.title: In Congress, a Sexual Harassment ‘Minefield’ Persists, Aides and Former Staff Say
news.summary: Nearly 10 years after Congress instituted measures to make it easier for women to lodge harassment complaints, lawmakers and aides say the behavior is still rampant.
